info.name: GitHub Get Announcement Banner for Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Gets the announcement banner currently set for the organization. Only returns the announcement banner set at the
organization level. Organization members may also see an enterprise-level announcement banner. To get an
announcement banner displayed at the enterprise level, use the enterprise-level endpoint.

info.name: GitHub Set Announcement Banner for Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs: Sets the announcement banner to display for the organization.

info.name: GitHub Remove Announcement Banner from Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs: Removes the announcement banner currently set for the organization.
